And while we're at it...
- "inpaint" is "edit a sub-zone of the larger image"
- "outpaint" is "extend the borders outward"
- "sharpen" is "identical, but clearer"
- "upscale" is "identical, with more pixels"
- "enhance" is sharpen + upscale + "rebuild at new higher res"

I need the #GenerativeAI industry to understand that words have meaning, and that randomly naming pipelines is insanity.

- "image-to-image" is "I have an image, but I need to tweak it"
- "reference-to-image" is "Use the character/object I have, but in another context"
- "style-to-image" is filters
